strategy.title: No plan: certified translation needs 60 owner hours against a 13-hour allowance
strategy.why: Ten written acceptances at $400 cover the $4,000 exactly, but the owner must do each translation personally at 6 hours per deal: 60 hours versus ~13 hours allowed (3/week over 30 days). At most 2 deals ($800) fit.

alternatives.title: Subcontract the translations to a certified translator
alternatives.why: No fulfiller other than the owner is on the card and no subcontractor price is evidenced; would need research before it could be planned.

sources.claim: 6 human hours per deal; the owner does the work personally

noPlan.decisiveGap: FULFILMENT within OWNER_HOURS: the only fulfiller is the owner at 6 hours per deal; 10 deals need 60 hours but only ~13 owner hours are allowed, so at most $800 can be delivered.
noPlan.resolution: Find and price a certified translator subcontractor (cost below $400 per job, settles within 30 days) so the owner's time per deal drops to under ~1.3 hours, or raise the owner-time allowance to ~15 hours/week.

excluded.why: Owner-fulfilled at 6 hours per deal; target needs 60 owner hours against a 13-hour allowance.

constraints.suggestion: Raise the owner allowance to at least 60 hours over the window (~15 hours/week), or add a subcontracted translator.
